plugin.name: Mafia Fusion Fix
CAMERA.FreeCamera.description: Orbit the car camera with the mouse or the right stick.
CAMERA.CameraReturnTimeout.description: Seconds without input before the camera returns behind the car.
CAMERA.CameraReturnSpeed.description: How fast the camera returns behind the car. 0 = never.
MAIN.PortableSettings.description: Keeps the game's registry settings in savegame\settings.bin.
GRAPHICS.ConsoleGamma.description: A gamma curve like the console versions of GTA IV.
GRAPHICS.AntiAliasing.description: Smooths jagged edges at a small cost.
GRAPHICS.RestoreEyeAnimations.descriptio: Uses the character models with moving eyes.
GRAPHICS.RestoreCarScratches.description: Restores the car scratches of version 1.0.
HUD.RadarMap.description: Xbox-style radar with larger car blips and speed-based zoom.
WIDESCREEN.WidescreenMap.description: Shows the map across the whole screen.
CUTSCENES.CutsceneBorders.description: Black bars of the cutscenes: above and below, at the sides, or both.
DRAW_DISTANCE.Enable.description: Uses the draw distance below instead of the game's.
GRAPHICS.DrawDistance.description: How far the world is drawn, in meters.
DRAW_DISTANCE.SkipMinDistance.descriptio: Nearest distance of the draw distance override.
DRAW_DISTANCE.SkipMaxDistance.descriptio: Farthest distance of the draw distance override.
MAIN.FPSLimit.description: Precise live frame limit. 0 = unlimited, -1 = monitor refresh rate. The engine keeps a minimum 1 ms simulation step. Default: 60 FPS.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the Plugins menu and the other plugins' texts. Automatic follows the game.
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
borderanimation.description: Slides the cutscene bars in and out. Off shows them at once.
hudconstraint.description: Auto uses the screen edges; a ratio keeps the HUD in a centered box.
fovfactor.description: Widens or narrows the on-foot and car camera. 1.0 = intended view.
skipintro.description: Skips the logo screens at startup.
windowmode.description: Fullscreen, a window, or borderless at the desktop resolution.
pauseonfocusloss.description: Pauses the game while another window is active.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window while it is active.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted in order to apply settings.
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Enhanced: everything turned up.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
MAIN.RawInputMouse.description: Uses native relative DirectInput mouse counts without the per-frame speed cap. Keeps the game sensitivity and inversion. Off restores the original limit.
MAIN.ResX.description: Output width; 0 uses the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.ResY.description: Output height; 0 uses the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Controller button pictures. Auto uses Xbox; choose PlayStation or Nintendo for another controller. Keyboard prompts follow keyboard input.
MAIN.ControllerLayout.description: Adds modern controller bindings alongside the saved keyboard and mouse controls. Original uses the game’s saved bindings. The game keeps reading its own DirectInput controller.
MAIN.GamepadCameraSpeed.description: Adjusts right-stick look speed with the Modern controller layout without changing mouse sensitivity.
MAIN.InvertGamepadY.description: Reverses vertical right-stick look with the Modern layout, relative to the game’s own inversion setting.
